description:
## What changed

**APKMirror's bundle download now patches.** APKMirror offers TikTok 46.2.3 two ways: a plain APK, and a bundle (an .apkm file) that Morphe Manager merges into one APK. The four optional cleanup patches refused the bundle (#9), because a merged bundle carries fewer files than the plain APK and only 25 of its 64 language packs. They now know that build too. Every file they empty is still checked byte for byte against the reviewed copy first, so nothing unrecognised is ever touched.

**AMOLED dark theme and bundles.** Putting everything onto a phone from the bundle showed one more problem: with AMOLED dark theme on, TikTok crashed at launch. AMOLED is the one patch that rebuilds TikTok's resources, and on a merged bundle that rebuild comes out missing about 1,400 resource files. The same patch on the plain APK is fine. AMOLED now refuses a merged bundle before changing anything and says why. Use the plain APK from APKMirror if you want the dark theme. Every other patch works on the bundle.

**Validation.** 1427 runtime tests and 240 patch tests passed locally. The receipt attached below records all 91 patches applying to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with the real desktop CLI. The APKMirror 46.2.3 bundle takes 90 of 91, AMOLED refusing it as intended, and that build ran on a Galaxy S22 with all five cleanup patches emptying their files, logged in and playing the feed. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
